name: How long does a paint job last, and what affects its longevity?

mainEntity.name: How long does a paint job last, and what affects its longevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of a paint job depends on several factors, including the quality of the paint and primer used, the thoroughness of surface preparation, the skill of application, and environmental conditions. A well-executed interior paint job can last 5-10 years or more, while exterior paint typically lasts 5-7 years in the East Bay's climate. Regular cleaning and maintenance can extend its life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint job longevity depends on paint quality, preparation, application, and environment; typically 5-10 years for interior, 5-7 for exterior.
